pages.headline: HACEMOS VISIONES
pages.description: Full-bleed interior: a double-height hospitality space with a wrought-iron balcony, a colourful figurative mural and an artificial-turf floor with a football goal. Caption: 'Evocaremos la magia de la transformación espacial y el poder de un diseño que trascienda lo visual.'
pages.text: Evocaremos la magia de la transformación espacial / y el poder de un diseño que trascienda lo visual.

pages.headline: DISEÑO RESIDENCIAL / HOTELERIA / COMERCIAL
pages.description: Capability page. Three gradient tiles with line illustrations (house, hotel, storefront) name the three markets; below, four icon tiles name the four capabilities INTERIORISMO, MOBILIARIO, ILUMINACION, CONSTRUCCION. At right, the 'Somos empresarios con visión de negocio' statement.

pages.description: Plate: a living room with a full-height timber-slat wall, a deep grey modular sofa, timber pendant cluster and a patterned rug.
Plate: a loft-like room with black steel-framed glazing onto greenery, a drop-down projector screen showing a film, a hammock and a low platform bed.
Plate: an indoor-outdoor dining and lounge space - exposed brick and concrete, a planted green wall, a tan leather sofa, a long timber table and a linear fireplace.
Plate: a bedroom with a timber-slat headboard wall, a large woven rattan pendant, and a bed on a raised timber platform.
Plate: a kitchen with a perforated timber wine wall, an island with pale timber stools, open black-steel shelving, integrated fridge and greenery.
Plate: a dining area against a full-wall 'Medellín' graffiti mural in hot colours, with a live-edge timber table, black wire chairs and an orange bench.
Plate: a bar/gaming room - a green-baize table, a large pop-art female mural, Moroccan pierced pendant lamps, red damask walls and gilt panelling.
Plate: an outdoor terrace over the valley - a pool with arcing water jets under a white steel pergola, artificial turf, a slide and a climbing wall.
Plate: a living room with floor-to-ceiling glazing onto the city, a white media unit with a large TV, turquoise upholstery and a pale sectional.
Plate: a study/office with a saturated yellow feature wall, a white desk and task chair, a black shelf with cameras and framed pieces.
Plate: a bedroom in soft neutrals - built-in wardrobes in pale timber, full-height curtains, an upholstered bench and a jacket on a stand.
Plate: a white spa/wellness room - a stone-clad wall with an inset screen and pebble niche, a deeply tufted white platform, gold accents and a small sculptural table.
Back cover: the gradient ALUZINA wordmark, the INTERIORISMO / ILUMINACIÓN lockup, the handle and phone, over a pale prism photograph. Mirrors the cover.
